body_degree_angle.sun:
The Sun takes a degree personally.

Whatever the image describes becomes the thing the person is trying to be, so the symbol reads less as a circumstance and more as a vocation.
body_degree_angle.moon:
The Moon does not interpret a degree, it absorbs it.

The image becomes the emotional weather of the childhood and the thing the body reaches for when tired, long before any of it is conscious.
body_degree_angle.mercury:
Mercury turns a degree into a way of thinking.

The image supplies the metaphors the mind reaches for first, and the person will explain unrelated things in its terms without noticing.
body_degree_angle.venus:
Venus makes a degree into a taste.

The image becomes what looks beautiful, what feels like worth, and what the person is drawn toward before they can give a reason.
body_degree_angle.mars:
Mars acts a degree out.

The image is not contemplated here, it is done - it describes what the person does when they are angry, wanting something, or out of patience.
body_degree_angle.jupiter:
Jupiter enlarges a degree into a belief.

The image becomes the story about how life works, which is why this placement is generous and why it overshoots.
body_degree_angle.saturn:
Saturn treats a degree as a duty.

The image is where the person expects to be found wanting, works too hard, and eventually becomes genuinely competent.
body_degree_angle.uranus:
Uranus breaks a degree open.

The image is where the person cannot be conventional even when it would cost them nothing to be, and where the sudden changes arrive.
body_degree_angle.neptune:
Neptune dissolves a degree.

The image becomes a longing rather than a fact, and the boundary between what the person imagines and what is there is thinnest here.
body_degree_angle.pluto:
Pluto buries a degree and then exhumes it.

The image is where power is at stake, where the person will not be moved, and where the life keeps insisting on the same crisis until something changes.
body_degree_angle.north_node:
The North Node makes a degree unfamiliar.

The image describes something the person is not yet good at and is nonetheless walking toward, which is why it feels both exposed and correct.
body_degree_angle.south_node:
The South Node makes a degree easy and slightly stale.

The image is something already mastered - so available it gets used to avoid the harder thing.
body_degree_angle.chiron:
Chiron makes a degree tender.

The image is where the person was hurt in a way that did not fully close, and consequently where they can see the same hurt in other people at a glance.
body_degree_angle.ceres:
Ceres feeds a degree.

The image becomes how the person cares and how they need to be cared for, and it governs what they do when someone they love is unwell.
body_degree_angle.pallas:
Pallas thinks strategically about a degree.

The image becomes a pattern the person can see in the abstract, argue from, and use to solve problems that are not obviously related to it.
body_degree_angle.juno:
Juno makes a degree a condition of partnership.

The image describes what the person requires from a committed other, and what constitutes betrayal if it is missing.
body_degree_angle.vesta:
Vesta keeps a degree sacred.

The image is what the person will go without other things in order to protect, and where their focus becomes total to the exclusion of comfort.
body_degree_angle.eris:
Eris will not let a degree be smoothed over.

The image is where the person names the thing everyone has agreed not to mention, and is disliked for it before being proved right.
body_degree_angle.eros:
Eros charges a degree.

The image becomes what is wanted rather than what is admired - the specific and slightly embarrassing shape of desire.
body_degree_angle.hygiea:
Hygiea makes a degree a matter of maintenance.

The image becomes something the person tends, prevents, and keeps clean, in the body and in the routines around it.
body_degree_angle.nessus:
Nessus makes a degree a question of what gets passed on.

The image is where harm has a history, and where the person either continues an inherited pattern or is the one who stops it.
body_degree_angle.pholus:
Pholus makes a degree a small cause with a large effect.

The image describes the minor act that opens a lid, after which the situation is no longer anybody's to control.
body_degree_angle.ascendant:
On the Ascendant a degree becomes visible.

The image is what people meet first - the manner, the physical impression, the thing said about the person before they have spoken.
body_degree_angle.descendant:
On the Descendant a degree arrives as other people.

The image describes who the person keeps attracting and what they habitually hand over to a partner rather than carry themselves.
body_degree_angle.mc:
On the Midheaven a degree becomes public.

The image is what the person is known for, what the career shapes itself around, and what strangers assume about their competence.
body_degree_angle.ic:
On the IC a degree goes underground.

The image is the private baseline - the family it came from, the room the person retreats to, and the thing they are unwilling to explain.
body_degree_angle.fortune:
The Part of Fortune makes a degree easy in a way the person undervalues.

The image describes where things go well without strain, which is precisely why it gets overlooked as a resource.
body_degree_angle.spirit:
The Part of Spirit makes a degree deliberate.

The image is what the person chooses rather than receives - the direction taken on purpose when nothing is compelling it.
body_degree_angle.lilith:
Black Moon Lilith makes a degree ungovernable.

The image is where the person refuses to be managed, and where the refusal costs them something they have decided to pay.

body_degree_composite.sun:
In a composite chart this is the relationship's reason to exist.

The degree describes not who either partner is but what the pairing is for - the thing it radiates when it is working and the purpose it loses when it drifts.
body_degree_composite.moon:
In a composite chart this is the domestic baseline - the non-verbal weather of the shared home.

The degree describes how the pair settles, what it does on an ordinary evening, and what it needs in order to feel safe together.
body_degree_composite.mercury:
In a composite chart this is how the pair thinks.

The degree describes the vocabulary of their conversations behind closed doors, their joint decision-making, and the subject they cannot discuss lightly.
body_degree_composite.venus:
In a composite chart this is the relationship's magnetic code - what it attracts, how it beautifies its surroundings, and what the pair collectively treats as valuable.

The degree describes the terms on which ease arrives.
body_degree_composite.mars:
In a composite chart this is the engine and the conflict style.

The degree describes how the pair takes action as one, and how it fights - which is a structural property of the bond rather than either temperament.
body_degree_composite.jupiter:
In a composite chart this is the shared horizon.

The degree describes the myth the pair believes about itself, where its luck arrives, and the direction it expands in when it stops being stuck.
body_degree_composite.saturn:
In a composite chart this is the skeleton and the karmic glue.

The degree describes the exact structural test the partnership must pass to survive, and the place it feels cold or dutiful while passing it.
body_degree_composite.uranus:
In a composite chart this is the destabilising point.

The degree describes how the pair shocks convention, where the sudden disruptions arrive, and how each liberates the other from their separate pasts.
body_degree_composite.neptune:
In a composite chart this is the shared dream and the point of disillusionment.

The degree describes the specific idealisation the pair co-creates, which is also where the eventual disappointment will be located.
body_degree_composite.pluto:
In a composite chart this is the crucible.

The degree describes the fated crisis the relationship keeps returning to, the power struggle it cannot talk its way out of, and what survives each purge.
body_degree_composite.north_node: In a composite chart this is the direction the pairing is growing toward - unfamiliar to both, awkward at first, and the reason the relationship exists at all if it is doing its work.
body_degree_composite.south_node: In a composite chart this is what the pair already knows how to do together, so well that it becomes the place they retreat to instead of attempting the harder thing.
body_degree_composite.chiron:
In a composite chart this is the shared wound - the pain the pair triggers in each other without meaning to.

Accepted rather than blamed, it becomes the specific thing they can offer other people.
body_degree_composite.ceres:
In a composite chart this is the hearth.

The degree describes how the pair feeds and tends each other in practice, and what happens to the bond when one of them is genuinely unwell.
body_degree_composite.pallas: In a composite chart this is the team's strategy - how the pair solves problems together, argues a case to the outside world, and divides the thinking between them.
body_degree_composite.juno:
In a composite chart this is the covenant.

The degree describes the actual contract of the partnership, where the power sits, and what either would experience as a breach of it.
body_degree_composite.vesta:
In a composite chart this is what the pair keeps sacred.

The degree describes what they will sacrifice comfort for, and the shared work that gets protected when everything else is negotiable.
body_degree_composite.eris:
In a composite chart this is the thing the pair will not let each other pretend about.

The degree describes the discord that turns out to be productive, and the peace it refuses to allow.
body_degree_composite.eros:
In a composite chart this is the charge between them.

The degree describes the specific shape of the attraction rather than its intensity, and what the pair wants from each other beneath what they admire.
body_degree_composite.hygiea:
In a composite chart this is what the relationship maintains.

The degree describes the routines that keep the bond well, and the neglect that makes it quietly unwell before anyone names it.
body_degree_composite.nessus:
In a composite chart this is the inherited harm.

The degree describes a pattern arriving from before either partner, and whether the pairing continues it or is the place it stops.
body_degree_composite.pholus:
In a composite chart this is the small act with the large consequence.

The degree describes the minor thing one of them does that opens something neither can then close.
body_degree_composite.ascendant: In a composite chart this is the relationship in public - what other people see when the pair walks in, and the impression the bond makes before either of them says anything.
body_degree_composite.descendant: In a composite chart this is what the pairing meets in the world: the kind of people it attracts as friends, allies and opponents, and what it habitually outsources rather than handling itself.
body_degree_composite.mc:
In a composite chart this is the relationship's public standing.

The degree describes what the pair is known for, and the reputation the bond acquires whether or not it was sought.
body_degree_composite.ic: In a composite chart this is the private floor of the relationship - the room only the two of them enter, and the thing about the bond neither explains to anyone else.
body_degree_composite.fortune: In a composite chart this is where the pairing has easy luck, and where it is likeliest to overlook a resource precisely because no effort was required to get it.
body_degree_composite.spirit: In a composite chart this is what the pair chooses on purpose - the direction taken deliberately rather than fallen into, and the part of the bond that is a decision rather than a circumstance.
body_degree_composite.lilith:
In a composite chart this is where the relationship will not be tamed.

The degree describes what the pair refuses to make respectable, and the price they have agreed to pay for refusing.
